_comment: Block-state hash table for 1.58 chunk builder. Maps block_id -> list of {hash,data,extra}. Authoritative block set: csvdef/utf8/blockdef.csv (3230 blocks). Hashes: runtime BlockStateContainer enumeration via GetBlockState per blockdef id (3161 with states; 69 stateless e.g. air excluded). Container-array hash = FindState lookup key = StateTable.f0. Extras default 0 (save-scan extras dropped as they duplicated runtime containers).
